items.title: Samagri Guidance or Arrangement Support

faqs.question: Can I book a pandit for Shradh rituals?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can book a verified pandit for Shradh rituals based on your city, date, language preference, ritual requirement, and availability.

faqs.question: Can I book a pandit for Pitru Karya or Tithi Pooja?
faqs.answer: Yes, pandits can be arranged for Pitru Karya, Tithi Pooja, annual death ceremony, Pitru Paksha rituals, and related requirements.

faqs.question: Can you help me understand which ritual is needed?
faqs.answer: Yes, our coordinator can understand your requirement and help connect you with a suitable pandit for guidance.

faqs.question: Will you help with samagri?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can share the samagri list in advance or help with samagri arrangement based on your requirement.

faqs.question: Can I get package details before booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, package details will be discussed before confirmation so you have clarity before proceeding.

faqs.question: Can I book urgently?
faqs.answer: Urgent bookings can be checked based on pandit availability in your city.
